continuity_derivation.filesystem_semantics: ext4 (all hosts): any write to file data updates mtime AND ctime; any metadata change (chmod/chown/link/rename/replace) updates ctime; creating a replacement file at the same path yields a NEW inode and updates the parent-directory mtime/ctime of the observed file's ctime. ctime cannot be set backward by unprivileged or ordinary privileged tooling (only via filesystem-image offline editing or the debugfs-style direct inode surgery on an unmounted device).
